summary: Comprehensive testing of iteration-2 features (TRC20 chain monitoring, async callbacks, audit logs). Backend: 16/17 pytest passed (94%). Frontend: all data-testids present and working for admin + merchant flows; wallet edit, chain-sync-btn, audit page filters, callbacks page notify-settings, sign preview, callback table, order create dialog with notify_url, checkout live/sim differentiation. Found 1 backend bug: GET /api/callbacks/sign-preview returns a sign_string that includes empty fields (remark=) while the actual HMAC signing filters them out, so merchants cannot reproduce the server sign using the returned sign_string.

minor.issue: Returned sign_string does not match the signing algorithm used by sign_payload(). The endpoint builds sign_string with `items = sorted((k, v) for k, v in sample.items() if k != 'sign')` (no empty-value filter), but sign_payload() excludes None/empty values. Result: HMAC-SHA256(api_secret, sign_string) != payload['sign'] when any payload field is empty (e.g. remark=''). Merchants following the preview will reject valid callbacks. Fix: in /callbacks/sign-preview, build items with the same filter `v is not None and v != ''` as sign_payload(). Reproduce: GET /callbacks/sign-preview as merchant; compute HMAC-SHA256 of returned sign_string with api_secret; compare to payload.sign.

action_items: Fix /api/callbacks/sign-preview to filter empty/None values in sign_string generation so it matches sign_payload().
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1121 lines (grew from 793). Strongly recommend splitting into modules: routes/{auth,orders,channels,accounts,callbacks,audit,chain}.py + services/{callback_worker,chain_listener}.py.
sign_payload and the sign_string returned by /callbacks/sign-preview use different filters (empty-value handling diverges) — see backend_issues above.

chain_listener() swallows exceptions globally but updates channel.sync_error only inside the per-channel try/except — good; however only triggers polling if there is a pending order with that wallet_address which skips historical confirmation if the order's expires_at already passed. Acceptable for MVP.
callback_worker polls every 5s but does not use a lock/claim pattern; if two workers ran, duplicate deliveries could occur. For single-process preview this is fine.
update_my_notify audit uses target_id=user['_id'] (ObjectId) which is converted to str in audit() — OK, but inconsistent with other audit calls that pass res.inserted_id. Not a bug.
manual_verify uses path param order_id (ObjectId) while other order endpoints use order_no (string). Inconsistent API design.
/orders/{order_no}/simulate-pay is still unauthenticated (acceptable for demo but a production risk).
list_audit_logs's `l` shadows builtin in list comprehension — pure style nit.

rca of the issue: Bug: /callbacks/sign-preview returns a sign_string that includes empty fields. RCA: in server.py the endpoint constructs items with a filter that only excludes 'sign' but sign_payload (used to compute the hash) additionally excludes None/''. Fix: change the endpoint's items construction to `items = sorted((k, v) for k, v in sample.items() if k != 'sign' and v is not None and v != '')` so the preview matches the signing algorithm the worker uses.
